title: local-workflow check refuses a doomed gate on a nearly full disk, as ship does
goal: ship and integrate refuse a gate before compiling when the candidate's filesystem is below the measured floor for the workspace, after reclaiming the ship's idle caches (T-DISKFULL-1); check ran its gates without that step. check now makes the same disk check against the worktree's own target before its gates, so an agent learns of a full disk in seconds instead of after a whole-workspace compile.
